en.content:
A geyser heats water flowing at a rate of 2.0 kg per minute from 30C to 70C. If geyser operates on a gas burner, the rate of combustion of fuel will be ___________ g min1.

[Heat of combustion = 8 103 Jg1, Specific heat of water = 4.2 Jg1 C1]
en.explanation:
kg/minute

= 42 g/min
